title: Identity Path: Component That Does Not Belong

steps.prompt: Match and reconcile rules are configured, yet Unified Link and Unified Individual tables stay empty after every run. Click the component that does not belong on the identity path.
steps.genericMissCopy: That element can be valid elsewhere in Data 360. It is not the intruder blocking identity outputs.

hotspots.missRationale: Calculated Insights consume unified profiles. They are downstream of identity, not a substitute for it.
Segments also sit after unified profiles. Empty Unified Individual tables mean identity never produced output.
Party DMOs are the normal mapped inputs to Identity Resolution, not the reason unify tables stay empty.
Unified Individual is the missing product of identity, not the intruder on the path.
The edge is wrong because of what it points at. The misplaced Data Action node is the component to remove from this path.

options.label: Replace Data Action with Identity Resolution before Unified Individual
options.rationale: Identity Resolution match and reconcile produces Unified Individual and Unified Link records. Data Actions push events after profiles exist—they cannot create those tables.

options.label: Keep Data Action and add a Calculated Insight to fabricate unified keys
options.rationale: Calculated Insights aggregate attributes; they do not run match/reconcile or populate Unified Link graphs.

options.label: Move segmentation ahead of Unified Individual to force profile creation
options.rationale: Segments require resolvable profile keys. Reordering activation steps cannot substitute for Identity Resolution.
